goal: Test the trial head across every frame of all seven inherited HD actions, beyond the originally selected attack poses
steps: Measured muzzle-tip world-space distance, vertical gap and longitudinal offset for each frame of all seven actions.
Rendered the worst-looking frames from actions 0, 1 and 3 in side view.
observations: Vertical tip gap becomes negative in actions 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 and 6; a negative landmark value alone is not proof of collision because y coordinates differ.
Side renders of action03 frame02 and action01 frame10 confirm visual muzzle-tip crossing and unacceptable bite geometry.
Selected open attack poses had hidden this defect. The graybox rig is not final-ready.
